title: Game dev + AI
hint: I wrote a book last year (of course). Now I'm creating a game of it, with the help of AI and MCP. I have set up a whole pipeline for AI-assisted prototyping, and I'm currently testing movement mechanics, AI behaviour and level design. I sketch and design the characters and describe the enviroments, and then I use AI to generate the 3D models and textures. I then import them into Godot and test them in the game engine.
